name: axcient-mcp
description: Every x360Recover endpoint, plus the fleet-wide backup-health answers the API alone can't give — offline, joined, and agent-ready.

axcient_api_key.title: AXCIENT_API_KEY
axcient_api_key.description: Sets AXCIENT_API_KEY for the Axcient x360Recover MCP server.

axcient_base_url.title: Axcient x360Recover API base URL
axcient_base_url.description: Base URL for the Axcient x360Recover API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

axcient_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
axcient_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to list only read-only tools: sync, import and every write tool are then not listed. Leave blank to keep every tool.
